welcome.title: Your first AI forecast is about ten minutes away
welcome.description: Forecast in a Box lets you configure, run and visualise AI weather forecasts on your own hardware — powered by ECMWF's Anemoi models and EarthKit tooling, using free open data.
welcome.learnMore: Learn more about <anemoi>ECMWF Anemoi</anemoi> and <earthkit>ECMWF EarthKit</earthkit>.

installPlugin.title: Install the ECMWF plugin
installPlugin.description: One plugin unlocks everything — models, data sources and map outputs.
installPlugin.locked: An administrator needs to install a plugin before Forecast in a Box can forecast. The next steps unlock automatically once that's done.

openRecipe.title: Open your first forecast recipe
openRecipe.description: A ready-made pipeline: AIFS reads yesterday's open data and draws temperature and pressure maps.

runForecast.title: Run it
runForecast.description: The first run also downloads the model — a few minutes, perfect for a coffee.
runForecast.failed: That run didn't finish — open the recipe and try again.

viewResults.title: See your maps
viewResults.description: Maps appear on the run page as each step completes.

installPlugin.title: First, the forecasting engine
installPlugin.body: Plugins provide the building blocks. The ECMWF plugin has everything you need today — click Install; it takes about a minute.

runOnce.title: Everything's configured
runOnce.body: Press Run Once to start your forecast. The first run downloads the model, so it can take a few minutes.

completion.title: That's a real AI weather forecast — and you just ran it.
completion.description: 2-metre temperature and mean-sea-level pressure, computed from open data on your own machine.
completion.next: Where to next: try longer lead times or other variables in the recipe, build a pipeline from a blank canvas, or browse the presets.
completion.reopenHint: You can reopen this guide any time from the Help button.

banner.noPluginsAdmin: Forecast in a Box needs a plugin before it can forecast.
banner.noPluginsUser: Forecast in a Box needs a plugin before it can forecast — ask your administrator to install one.
